locatorcolors.option.colorize_chat.toolt: Applies player locator colors to names and mentions in chat messages.
locatorcolors.option.colorize_tab_list.t: Applies the player's locator color to their name in the player list.
Applies the player's locator color to the nameplate rendered above their character.
locatorcolors.option.colorize_self.toolt: If disabled, your own name will remain its default color across chat, tab list, and name tags.
locatorcolors.option.locator_head_mode.t: Renders player heads on the locator bar when holding the player list key (Tab) or inspect key.
Always renders player heads on the locator bar.
Never renders player heads on the locator bar.
locatorcolors.option.show_head_borders.t: If disabled, player heads on the locator bar will be rendered without the colored border.
locatorcolors.option.show_locator_distan: Displays the distance to tracked players below their locator icon when inspecting.
